item.title: Davidson and Strangeworks Partner on Hybrid Quantum Defense Optimization
item.summary: Aerospace and defense engineering contractor Davidson and quantum orchestration platform Strangeworks have announced a strategic collaboration focused on quantum-enabled optimization for military mission planning.
